svg.aria-label: By the numbers: about 1,500 hours building a thrust vectored UAV; over 450 million RL simulation steps; 98 percent of goals reached by the RL hexapod with zero falls; YOLO inference from 35 to 6 ms; over 1,000 GitHub contributions in 2026; over 47 thousand lines of code since May; about 150 pull requests merged; zero lines of hand written gait.
